text:
Maria (Product): heads-up — we need to lock launch criteria for the Cost‑Aware SLA gates feature by EOD Friday. customers expect predictable token costs + soft-fallbacks for spikes.
Ajay (Eng-runtime): can you list the must-haves vs nice-to-haves? runtime needs to know what to guarantee.
Maria (Product): must-haves: 1) p95 gen latency <= 150ms for the small prompt cohort, 2) automatic fallback to quantized variant when capacity low, 3) circuit for cost cap per-tenant with graceful degrade messaging. nice-to-have: adaptive batch tuning on rollout.
Ken (Eng-infra): for the cost cap we need a quota token and a reserve slot model. rough ask: reserve 2x burst slots for canary tenants for 3 regions. that's a capacity commit.
Olivia (Security): KMS/HSM gating for customer-managed keys — do we need additional audit schema for these new quota events?
Sarah P (ProdOps): want a clear runbook: when quota triggers, what gets logged, who pages, what's user-visible (error vs degraded response). current runbook for prewarm won't cover cost caps.
Ajay (Eng-runtime): runtime tasks: - implement per-tenant budget check in router - fallback path to quantized-4bit model - emit metric: quota_remaining and quota_throttle_count. Need infra to expose reserve slots API.
Ken (Eng-infra): API spec: POST /reserve_slots {tenant_id, region, slots, duration}. We'll prototype with 10-tenants. Also need autoscaler knob to honor reserved buckets.
Sebastian (SRE): we need alerts: quota_throttle_count spike > 5/min -> SEV3, sustained > 100/min -> SEV2. Also latency regression after fallback should alert.
Olivia (Security): audit events: quota_reserve.created, quota_throttle.triggered, fallback.invoked. Each event must include key_id if customer KMS used. We need a short PRD for logging retention and access controls.
Maria (Product): launch criteria proposal: (A) feature gated in prod behind ff_cost_aware_sla, (B) E2E tests covering reserve/resume/fallback, (C) security signoff on audit events, (D) capacity commit for canary tenants in 3 regions, (E) runbook and pager assignment.
Ajay (Eng-runtime): timeline: we can have a dev-canary in 2 weeks if infra provides reserve_slots API and ops provides runbook. Otherwise slips to 4 weeks.
Ken (Eng-infra): I can spin up the API hook in a week but need capacity spec: how many slots per-tenants and expected qps during burst. Maria, can you share traffic profile for canary?
Maria (Product): canary customers: Acme, Beacon, and LumenHealth. expected peak qps per tenant 40 req/s with average token length 80. reserve plan: 4 slots per tenant initially.
Ajay (Eng-runtime): 4 slots x 3 tenants x 3 regions -> runtime estimate: need ~12 GPU slots active (accounting for locality). I'll add batching change: conservative batch size cap so latency holds.
Sarah P (ProdOps): runbook stub: Step 1: detect quota_throttle -> Step 2: trigger degrade message -> Step 3: contact oncall (product-op list) -> Step 4: if fallback triggers, escalate to runtime oncall. I'll write and share.
Olivia (Security): I can review audit PR within 48h once Ajay emits schema. Also need a short privacy note for customers about cost-fallbacks.
Ajay (Eng-runtime): initial logging schema: event, tenant_id, region, fallback_model, latency_ms, quota_remaining. I'll paste example:```
{
  "event":"fallback.invoked",
  "tenant_id":"acme",
  "region":"us-west-2",
  "fallback_model":"gpt-small-quant4",
  "latency_ms":132,
  "quota_remaining":1200
}
```
Ken (Eng-infra): infra acceptance: reserve_slots API must support idempotency and RBAC. Also need DB column for reserved_until to avoid leaks.
Sebastian (SRE): chaos test: simulate sudden drop in capacity and ensure fallback keeps p95 under 300ms and errors < 0.5%. We'll run on staging.
Maria (Product): tradeoffs: if runtime fallback increases hallucination risk we must limit to non-sensitive customers first. Also product asks for a 'rollback-to-last-model' policy if quality regressions detected.
Ajay (Eng-runtime): agree — we'll make fallback configurable per-tenant (enable_quality_guard boolean). For canary we'll keep it off for regulated tenants.
Sarah P (ProdOps): gating checklist for launch: 1) infra API up in staging, 2) runtime fallback implemented + unit tests, 3) security audit PR merged, 4) runbook published, 5) canary tenants onboarded into reserve test, 6) chaos test passed.
Olivia (Security): add: encryption in transit for reserve API and signed audit entries.
Ken (Eng-infra): noted. Also will estimate cost delta of reserved slots and share budget number by Wednesday.
Maria (Product): OK next steps: - @Ken: deliver API proto by Wed EOD - @Ajay: runtime fallback prototype + logging schema by Fri - @Olivia: audit requirements doc by Fri - @Sarah P: runbook draft by Thu - I'll camp with customers for acceptance criteria and confirm canary qps.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window requested: 2026-06-15 02:00-04:00 UTC for infra changes.
Sebastian (SRE): that window works for chaos testing after deploy. Add me to deploy.
Ken (Eng-infra): ack, will push API in that window if approved.
Maria (Product): thanks everyone — let's regroup Thu morning for preflight. :thumbsup:
Olivia (Security): +1, will start review as soon as schema lands.
Ajay (Eng-runtime): i'll open a draft PR for the fallback path later today.
Sarah P (ProdOps): I'll seed the runbook with paging roster and smoke checks.
Maria (Product): end-of-thread checklist: everyone added action items above. If anything else pops up, ping here or DM.
